content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Biloxi

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP requires either a bachelor's degree plus documented project-management experience, or a high school diploma with additional years of hands-on experience. Review PMI's specific education and experience thresholds to confirm you meet the baseline. Eligibility verification happens before you apply, so verify now to avoid delays.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Our PMI Authorized Partner instructors deliver the required contact hours online, allowing you to learn on your schedule while meeting PMI's formal education mandate. Completion of this course satisfies the education requirement for your PMP application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing our training, submit your PMP application directly to PMI, including your course completion documentation and proof of your project-management experience. Pay the associated PMI exam fee at application. PMI will review and approve your eligibility before you're cleared to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation support to strengthen your readiness. Study the PMBOK® Guide, review practice questions, and use our resources to build confidence. Schedule your exam with PMI's testing partner when you feel prepared, then take the computer-based PMP exam at an authorized testing center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP is valid for three years. Throughout your renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) by participating in approved project-management activities, training, and volunteer work. Before expiration, submit your earned PDUs and renewal fee to PMI to keep your credential active and current.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
